source_quote: Bear case tomorrow: Resumes below 7567. These types of level loss shorts below a support are called breakdown trades. My core edge is failed breakdowns, and the reason is this is an edge is the vast majority of break downs (80%) trap. I do not take these trades personally.
text: Bear case: resumes below 7567 — a breakdown trade below a support. He does not take these personally (low win rate, high R/R; expect over 60% to fail). For the 7567 short, ideally a final bounce or a Failed Breakdown first, then short beneath the lows of that bounce; likely 7558 trigger down.

source_quote: After a shelf of lows fails, ES then repeats the cycle where Failed Breakdowns/rips occur when and if that shelf recovers. Until then, bears retain some control. This also means we should be suspect of supports.
text: Regime: after a shelf of lows fails, Failed Breakdowns/rips return when and if that shelf recovers; until then bears retain some control, supports are softer, and directly buying supports is risky especially if ES is rapidly going elevator down.
